name: Unemployment Allowance to Disabled Persons
benefit: > To all categories of Handicapped Persons: ₹500/-  per month.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be an unemployed person.
1. The applicant's age should be between 18-30 years.
1. The applicant's total family income of parents should not exceed ₹ 1,50,000/- per annum.
1. The applicants should have a minimum of two years of registration in the Special Employment Exchange in the U.T. Chandigarh.
1. The applicants should have been residing in U.T. Chandigarh for at least three years immediately before the submission.
